subject: Heads of Research Dinner | CVPR'25 | 14 June
text:
Hi [NAME],

I saw you're presenting your poster at CVPR this year, so I wanted to reach
out with an invite from our Head of ML [SENDER] . He's hosting
a dinner and fireside chat for Heads of Research/ Applied Science attending
the conference on Saturday (6/14) & would love to welcome you!

We'll kick off at 6:30pm with a fireside chat with Luc Vincent (Chief R&D
Officer at Nexar, formerly VP of AI at Meta) as he reflects on his career
and the toughest challenges still facing teams scaling computer vision
models today.

The discussion will continue over dinner, joined by Heads of AI from
Captions, Adobe, Synthesia, etc.

In case Encord is new to you... we help over 200 AI teams improve data
quality for model development, with the goals of reducing time spent on
training dataset preparation & accelerate model iterations.

Happy to share details if you're in Nashville then?

subject: Ex-VP of AI at Meta, now Nexar Fireside Chat + Dinner Invite
text:
Hi [NAME],

If you're attending CVPR this year? If so, I'd love to personally invite
you to a small dinner we're hosting for a group of AI leaders on 06/14.

We'll kick off with a fireside chat with Luc Vincent-ex-VP of AI at Meta,
Chief R&D Officer at Nexar, and investor/advisor at Encord- followed by
dinner for AI leaders in Nashville on the Saturday of CVPR - we'd love for
you to join if you're interested / can make it!

Attendees are strictly reserved for senior leaders (CTOs, Heads of ML,
Co-founders) from our existing Encord partners and/or other leading AI/ML
scale-ups and orgs - confirmed are Nexar, Woven by Toyota from the
automotive space and others.

A bit of context on Encord - we help over 200 AI teams improve data quality
for model development. We focus on consolidating data curation, annotation
and model evaluation with the goals of efficiency gains for training
dataset preparation & model iterations.

Let me know if you're interested/free - happy to send over the full details.

subject: Congrats on your Series A!
text:
Hi [NAME] - congrats on your Series A announcement!

I saw you're hiring an engineer to scale your annotation infrastructure &
reminds me of our work w/ Nexar, Flock Safety & Motive who are also
building road safety models. Thought it's worth connecting.

We mainly help those teams increase visibility on their annotation
workflows and make their pipelines more scalable, with the goals of
improving consistency of their training dataset preparation and increasing
labelling throughput.

Happy to share our perspectives if you're open to a quick chat Tuesday to
Friday next week? We'll also be at CVPR if you prefer connecting in person.
